_comment: WORKFLOW-DEFINITION-DRIFT-1 (issue #1669). Canonical source of truth for live qnfo-audit fleet_tasks.definition values. The D1 table fleet_tasks_canonical is seeded from this file and a drift-gate fleet_task (fleet-tasks-drift-gate) files an agent_issue whenever the live definition differs from the canonical copy. Exported 2026-09-30 by qnfo-ops from qnfo-audit.

self-audit-systemwide.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-TOOLERR: ' || text, 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide (SELF-AUDIT-SYSTEMWIDE-1). 24h tool error-rate breach for tool ' || text || ': ' || SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) || ' errors out of ' || COUNT(*) || ' calls. Classify as agent misuse vs tool defect before fixing.', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','medium','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM tool_error_rate_24h WHERE ts > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z','now','-24 hours') GROUP BY text HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) > 0.15 AND SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' AND ts > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z','now','-2 hours') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-TOOLERR: ' || tool_error_rate_24h.text AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-CRONSTALE: ' || name, 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide (SELF-AUDIT-SYSTEMWIDE-1). Sub-daily cron ' || name || ' (task_id ' || task_id || ', expr ' || cron_expr || ') last fired ' || COALESCE(last_fired,'never') || ', which is older than 3h, or the cron has never fired since it was created. This predicate covers the DISPATCH-FIRER-MISSING class (a declared schedule with no firer). Check cron_fire_log and the owning worker trigger.', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM fleet_crons WHERE enabled=1 AND (cron_expr='0 * * * *' OR cron_expr LIKE '*/%') AND ((last_fired IS NOT NULL AND julianday('now') - julianday(replace(last_fired,'T',' ')) > 0.125) OR (last_fired IS NULL AND julianday('now') - julianday(updated_at) > 0.125)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-CRONSTALE: ' || fleet_crons.name AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-NULLTS: agent_issues timestamp regression', 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide. ' || COUNT(*) || ' agent_issues rows have NULL created_at or updated_at. Regression of DEFAULT-TS-1 (agent_issues_created_at_default_ins / agent_issues_updated_at_default_ins, fixed 2026-09-29). NULL timestamps break recency ordering, SLA math and the self-audit staleness predicates.', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM agent_issues WHERE created_at IS NULL OR updated_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-NULLTS: agent_issues timestamp regression' AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-TRIGGERMISSING: ' || j.value, 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide. Critical guard trigger ' || j.value || ' is ABSENT from qnfo-audit. Without it the invariant it enforces silently stops being enforced (the class that let unclassified noise tickets file and let close-without-evidence writes through).', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM json_each('[\"agent_issues_created_at_default_ins\",\"agent_issues_updated_at_default_ins\",\"issue_close_evidence_required\",\"agent_issues_autotriage2_ins\",\"agent_issues_normalise_tick\",\"agent_issues_recheck_count_upd\"]') j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master s WHERE s.type='trigger' AND s.name = j.value) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-TRIGGERMISSING: ' || j.value AND a.status='open')"}]}
